title: ParallelFor
author: JG
description: use ParallelFor with costs argument in GeneralContact and CSystem, to optimize usage
workingRemarks: part of revision2026c step RG9.11.5 (2026-11-01), the cost per item of the parallel Jacobians of #3201; Evaluated in revision2026c step RG9.11.5.2 (design docs/dev/design/systemJacobians.md section 9): the parallel Jacobians split into 16 tasks per thread of equal numbers of items, taken as threads become free, reach 90 % of the ideal at 8 threads for 2000 joints; ParallelFor's cost argument only switches small loops to serial, which the multithreadedLowerLimit settings do. Proposed: close as superseded (RG9.11.5.3).
